info.name: Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 Abort Journeys API

params.name: page
params.description: The page number to retrieve. Defaults to 1.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of journeys to return per page. Defaults to 50.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter journeys by status. Use Draft, Published, ScheduledToSend, Stopped, or Deleted.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of Marketing Cloud Journey Builder journeys (interactions). Includes both active and inactive journeys. Use the page and pageSize parameters to paginate. Can filter by journey status.

params.name: interactionId
params.description: The unique ID of the journey (interaction) to retrieve.

params.name: versionNumber
params.description: The version number of the journey to retrieve. If not specified, returns the latest version.

items.docs: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Marketing Cloud Journey Builder journey, including its activities, triggers, goals, and current status.

Fires an event that causes contacts to enter a Marketing Cloud Journey Builder journey at the specified event-triggered entry source. The event definition key must match an API event or custom event configured as the journey's entry source. Supports passing contact data to personalize the journey experience.
